thread.title: Amazon, Apple Posting Notable Losses In Late-Day Trading

author: nasdaq.com
title: Amazon, Apple Posting Notable Losses In Late-Day Trading
text:
Shutterstock photo
( RTTNews.com ) - Shares of Amazon.com, Inc., (AMZN) and Apple Inc. ( AAPL ) are seeing notable weakness in late-day trading on Thursday, slumping by 2.3 percent and 1.9 percent, respectively.
Amazon is on pace to end the session at its lowest closing level in over a month, while Apple is pulling back off a record closing high.
The drops by Amazon and Apple come after a report from Bloomberg Businessweek said China secretly inserted surveillance microchips into servers used by companies. Both companies dispute the report.
